video.title: MiniMax H3 in ComfyUI: long videos from chained renders

summary: MiniMax H3 renders top out at about fifteen seconds. To get past that, every render opens on an exact replay of the last 39 frames of the render before it, so the join is the same frames rather than similar frames. Character, street and voice all stay put across it.
References are handed in per render, so a new character or a new block of street can arrive halfway through a take. Twenty seven prompts across five takes, one per render, copied from what was sent.
facts: 39 frames plus audio from the end of each render
<Picture N> is positional: it comes from the order images are wired in, not from the prompt
non_diegetic_music is N/A in all twenty seven; score goes on over the finished cut
